pitch: "Same program, two campaigns, one belt." Sean and Cat run the identical 6-day program from different starting steps, and the two-player layer never asks who lifts more — it asks who executed THEIR OWN prescription better this week. Everything is relative-to-self and capped, so the weaker beginner can win any given week on effort and consistency alone, while the stronger one cannot coast. Three loops: (1) a DUO STREAK that counts shared training days and treats rest/sick/travel days as neutral instead of broken; (2) a weekly HEAD-TO-HEAD for "The Belt", scored 0–100 from five self-relative categories, with a Dead-Heat tie, No-Contest weeks for illness, and an automatic "Alliance Week" after three straight losses so nobody sits in a losing streak; (3) every-4-week CO-OP BOSS BATTLES built on the Köhler principle — combined damage = A + B + min(A,B), so the weaker partner's contribution is counted twice and is genuinely indispensable. Research basis: partnered/conjunctive exercise reliably produces motivation gains for the less-capable partner (Irwin, Feltz et al. 2012, Annals of Behavioral Medicine: cyclists with a conjunctive partner persisted ~675 s longer per session over six sessions; Forlenza et al. 2012: the effect is strongest when the partner is moderately, not vastly, more capable — which our normalisation enforces artificially); social comparison beat passive social support for raising activity in a randomised online-network trial (Zhang et al. 2016, Preventive Medicine Reports); and adults who joined a fitness programme with a spouse showed far lower 12-month dropout than singles (Wallace et al. 1995). Sources: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22576339/ , https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/abs/10.1089/g4h.2012.0047 , https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2211335516300936 , https://www.researchgate.net/publication/14426469_Twelve_month_adherence_of_adults_who_joined_a_fitness_program_with_a_spouse_vs_without_a_spouse , https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8404361/ . Everything below is deterministic from the two users' synced JSON, so both phones compute identical results with no server.
fairness_model:
PRINCIPLE: every scored quantity is (what you did) ÷ (what YOUR program prescribed you this week), capped at 100, so a 12-lb goblet squat at step 2 and a 35-lb goblet squat at step 7 are worth exactly the same when both hit their targets. Absolute load, absolute reps, absolute speed and body metrics never enter any formula.

FAILURE MODES OF NAIVE COMPARISON (and the fix):
1. Comparing absolute load/reps/volume (e.g. total lb lifted, push-ups done): Sean wins every week from day 1 for 12+ weeks; Cat disengages by week 3. FIX: only self-relative ratios.
2. Comparing raw XP: if the single-player XP system rewards volume or load (likely), it inherits failure #1; even if flat per session, it silently rewards whoever's schedule allows more sessions. FIX: XP is scored as xp_week / xp_available_week (the max XP the prescribed week could earn), capped at 100.
3. Comparing "percentage of targets hit" alone: both quickly sit at 90–100% → permanent ties, no signal, no rivalry. FIX: it is one of five weighted categories; ties are a legitimate but narrow outcome (|ΔS| < 2).
4. Comparing ladder steps gained: beginners at lower steps advance FASTER (wall → incline push-up takes days; step 9 → 10 takes weeks), so this is biased TOWARD the weaker partner and dries up for both after ~week 8. FIX: it is capped (3 steps = 100) and weighted only 15%, so it is a spice, not the meal; benchmark tier climbs are scored the same way.
5. Comparing Zone-2 minutes absolute: rewards free time, not effort, and incentivises overtraining. FIX: ratio to prescribed minutes, capped at 100 (no credit above prescription).
6. Uncapped anything: encourages junk volume for points, unsafe for beginners. FIX: every category caps at 100; overall S caps at 100.
7. All-or-nothing weeks: one sick day = lost week = resentment. FIX: fidelity is averaged over sessions COMPLETED (not over 6), sessions-completed is the only category that pays for volume, and declared sick/travel days convert to No-Contest rules (see scoreboard).
8. Runaway loser: even with self-relative scoring, one partner may lose 4+ weeks straight through life circumstances. FIX: Alliance Week trigger + Personal-Best star (below).
9. Hidden handicaps (secretly making the weaker partner's ladder easier): feels patronising when discovered and corrupts the training program. FIX: no handicap coefficients anywhere; the only asymmetry is the per-user placement start step, which is program design, not scoring.

WEEKLY SCORE S (0–100), computed per user u for ISO week w (Mon–Sun, local time):
  sessions_pct = min(100, 100 * sessions_completed / sessions_prescribed)          // sessions_prescribed = 6 (5 if a declared shield day falls on a training day; see streak rules)
  fidelity_pct = 100 * mean over completed sessions of (exercises_hit / exercises_prescribed) // 0 if no sessions
  zone2_pct    = min(100, 100 * zone2_min_done / zone2_min_prescribed)
  progress_pct = min(100, 34 * ladder_steps_gained + 50 * benchmark_tier_climbs)  // steps across all ladders; tier climbs only in benchmark weeks
  xp_pct       = min(100, 100 * xp_week / xp_available_week)                        // requires single-player designer to publish xp_available_week; if absent, fold its 0.10 into sessions (0.40)
  S = round(0.30*sessions_pct + 0.25*fidelity_pct + 0.20*zone2_pct + 0.15*progress_pct + 0.10*xp_pct)

"Session completed" = status "complete" with duration_min >= 20 AND exercises_hit/exercises_prescribed >= 0.6, OR a pure Zone-2 treadmill session with zone2_min >= 20. "Exercise hit" = the logged top set met the prescribed reps (or seconds) at the prescribed step; a treadmill block is hit if minutes_in_zone >= prescribed minutes. Both are already required by the ladders' machine-checkable advance rules, so no extra logging.

PERSONAL-BEST STAR (decouples winning from the partner): if S_u >= max(S_u over the previous 4 contested weeks) + 5, user u gets a PB star for the week regardless of result. A losing week with a PB star is displayed as "Lost the belt, set a PB" — the copy leads with the PB.

ALLIANCE WEEK (anti-runaway): if a user has lost 3 consecutive CONTESTED weeks, the next week is automatically an Alliance Week: no belt change is possible; both win a shared "Alliance" crown if S_a + S_b >= 150, else nobody loses. After an Alliance Week the consecutive-loss counter resets to 0. This is disclosed on the scoreboard ("Alliance Week — win together or not at all").

BENCHMARK / BOSS NORMALISATION: improvement is relative to each user's own previous benchmark: imp = (new − prev) / prev for reps, distance and hold-time benchmarks; imp = (prev − new) / prev for time-to-complete benchmarks. Tier tables (0–5 per benchmark) are defined by the single-player designer; tier climbs count identically at every tier. Because both partners are beginners, improvement percentages are large for both in weeks 4 and 8 and the boss HP schedule tapers to match (see boss battles).

EXPECTED DYNAMICS OVER 12 WEEKS: weeks 1–4, the weaker partner typically gains more ladder steps (progress_pct favours her) while the stronger partner may hit more targets — scores land within ±10 and the belt swaps hands. Weeks 5–12, progress slows for both and the contest becomes sessions + fidelity + Zone-2, i.e. pure execution — still winnable by either. No category can be won by being stronger.
duo_streak_rules:
DEFINITIONS
- Each user has rest_weekday (0–6) set at onboarding; they may differ.
- day_status for user u on date d is one of: "trained" (>= 1 completed session, as defined in fairness), "rest" (d is u's rest_weekday, or u explicitly logged rest), "shield" (declared sick/travel/injury), "none" (nothing logged).
- A date is DUO-REQUIRED if it is a training day for BOTH users (neither's rest_weekday). If rest days coincide there are 6 duo-required days per week; if they differ, 5.

STREAK ALGORITHM (each phone runs it identically over both users' day files, iterating dates from the first common date to yesterday; today is shown as "pending" until both have trained or the day ends):
  for each date d in order:
    if d is not duo-required: neutral (streak unchanged)
    else if status_sean == "trained" and status_cat == "trained": streak += 1
    else if either status == "shield" (and the other is "trained" or "shield"): neutral, shield_days_used += 1 for that user
    else: break → ember = floor(streak / 2), ember_expires = d + 14 days, streak = 0
  A day is finalised at 23:59 local of the NEXT day (allows late logging of "I did train yesterday"); before that it is "pending" and cannot break the streak.

SHIELDS (sick / travelling / injured)
- Each user has 2 shields per rolling 30 days. A shield is declared in-app with a reason (sick, travel, injury, life); it may be declared retroactively up to 48 h after the day (sick people do not open apps). Shields consume no streak and count the day as neutral for the duo streak.
- A shield can be "multi-day": declaring travel with a date range uses 1 shield per duo-required day in the range, up to the remaining shield balance; a declared range beyond the balance is accepted for the sessions/No-Contest logic but the streak breaks on the first uncovered duo-required day.
- Hard cap: if more than 5 consecutive duo-required days are neutral (any mix of shields), the streak freezes at its value ("paused") and cannot grow until a shared trained day occurs; it does not break. If the pause exceeds 14 consecutive duo-required days, the streak breaks with an ember as above.
- A partner's shield never costs the OTHER partner anything: their personal streak, sessions and weekly score are unaffected.

REST DAYS
- Rest days are neutral, never counted, never broken. Training on your rest day counts as "trained" for the sessions category but does not add a duo day (prevents 7-day grind for streak points).
- If both users share a rest_weekday, the streak display shows a small "rest" dot for that day rather than a gap.

RECOVERY ("Rekindle")
- After a break, an ember of floor(previous_streak / 2) is stored with a 14-day expiry. If the pair completes 3 consecutive duo-required days both "trained" before expiry, the streak is set to ember + 3 instead of 3, and the badge "rekindled" fires (once per ember). If the ember expires unused it is discarded. Only one ember exists at a time; a second break before the ember is used replaces it with floor(new_streak / 2) only if that is larger.

MILESTONES (surface in UI, also feed badges): 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90 duo days. Display: a two-flame icon with the count; "pending" state shows one flame lit when exactly one partner has trained today.

LONGEST DUO STREAK is stored and shown alongside current streak so a break never erases the achievement.
weekly_scoreboard:
WEEK = ISO week, Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59 local (both users are in one household; the logging phone's date string is authoritative).

WHAT IS SCORED: the five self-relative categories from the fairness model, giving S_sean and S_cat in 0–100:
  S = round(0.30*sessions_pct + 0.25*fidelity_pct + 0.20*zone2_pct + 0.15*progress_pct + 0.10*xp_pct)
Each category is shown as a paired horizontal bar (yours vs partner's percentage) with NO absolute numbers underneath — only the percentages and, for progress, the ladder step NAMES gained (e.g. "Goblet squat → 20 lb", "Push-up → Incline II"), which are shared progress facts, not body metrics.

CONTEST STATUS (evaluated at resolution):
  contested   = both users have sessions_completed >= 2 AND neither user has >= 3 shield days in the week
  no_contest  = otherwise, EXCEPT the unexplained-absence case below
  unexplained = a user has 0 completed sessions AND 0 shield days AND the partner has >= 2 sessions → the absent user loses the week (contest still counts for belt), copy is neutral: "Sean sat this week out — belt stays with Cat" (never "missed", "lazy", "failed").
  alliance    = the next week after any user records 3 consecutive contested losses (see fairness model); belt frozen; shared crown if S_a + S_b >= 150.

RESOLUTION TIMELINE (no server; every phone computes on open):
- From Monday 00:00 the previous week is "provisional": each phone computes it from whatever partner data it has and shows "provisional — waiting for <partner>'s sync" if the partner's week file updated_at is older than Sunday 18:00.
- The week LOCKS at Tuesday 23:59 local (48 h grace for late logging or late sync). After lock, both phones recompute once with the locked inputs and write the result into their OWN file (users/<me>/weeks/<isoweek>.json → result block). Because the inputs are identical and the algorithm is deterministic, both files agree; if they disagree (one phone locked with stale data), the one with the later `partner_updated_at` stamp wins, and the other phone silently re-writes on next open.
- Belt holder and crown counts are derived by replaying all locked weeks in order, never stored as mutable state — so a corrected week automatically corrects the cabinet.

WINNER / TIE RULES:
  if not contested: result = "no_contest" (no crown, belt unchanged, loss counters unchanged, week excluded from PB baselines)
  else if |S_a − S_b| < 2: result = "dead_heat" — both get a half crown (0.5), belt unchanged, loss counters reset to 0 for both
  else: winner = higher S; winner gets 1 crown, belt moves to winner; loser's consecutive_losses += 1, winner's resets to 0
  Dead heat is deliberately a real outcome (no arbitrary tie-breaker on a 1-point difference); a second consecutive dead heat awards the badge "dead_heat".

THE TROPHY / BRAGGING ARTEFACT — "THE BELT":
- One belt, like a boxing title: it lives on the home screen of the holder as a gold belt on their avatar, and on the challenger's screen as "Cat holds the belt — 5 days to take it". A belt cannot be won in a no-contest or alliance week.
- Belt record line: "Held 3 weeks · 5 title changes this season". A "defence" counts each contested week the holder keeps the belt (win or dead heat).
- CROWN CABINET: per-user tally of crowns (1 per win, 0.5 per dead heat, 1 shared Alliance crown each), boss trophies, and duo badges. The cabinet shows both users side by side.
- SHARE CARD: on resolution the app renders a 1080×1350 PNG on a <canvas> ("Week 37 — Cat 91 · Sean 84 — category bars — Belt: Cat, 2nd defence") saved to the device photo roll via long-press; it contains percentages and step names only, never loads, weights or body metrics. It is generated locally and never committed to the repo.
- SEASON: 12 weeks = 1 season, aligned to the program's 12-week block. Season champion = most crowns; if equal, most dead heats; if still equal, "co-champions". The season champion gets a permanent cabinet plaque; belt history resets to "vacant" at season start so the second season starts fresh.

WHAT THE WINNER SEES: "You took the belt — 91 to 84. Cat's Zone-2 was perfect this week (100%); your edge was 6/6 sessions." (Always names one thing the loser did BEST — machine rule: display the loser's highest category.)
WHAT THE LOSER SEES: "Cat took the belt — 84 to 91. Your best: 100% Zone-2. Closest gap: sessions (5/6 vs 6/6) — one more session would have tied it." (Machine rule: display the loser's highest category + the single category whose closure would have changed the result, computed by trying each category at 100 for the loser.) If the loser earned a PB star, that line goes first.

ONE-PERSON-SICK WEEKS: >= 3 shield days → no_contest automatically; 1–2 shield days → sessions_prescribed for that user is reduced by the number of shield days that fell on training days (so 4/4 = 100%), the week stays contested. A user may also manually mark a week "no contest" until Tuesday lock for reasons the app cannot know (bereavement etc.) — this requires a reason string and is visible to the partner as "Sean paused the contest this week".
coop_boss_battles:
SCHEDULE: benchmark weeks are program weeks 4, 8, 12 (and every 4 thereafter); week 0 placement quiz + first benchmark session provide baselines. A boss battle opens Monday of the benchmark week and stays open through the following Sunday (14-day window) so both partners can complete all benchmarks; the battle resolves when both users have every benchmark logged, or at window close.

BENCHMARK SET (shared with single-player; each yields a numeric value and a tier 0–5 per the single-player tier tables; uses only the allowed equipment): 
  push_max (max clean push-ups at the user's current ladder variant, recorded with variant id), 
  plank_hold_s, 
  goblet_squat_reps_at_step (reps at the user's CURRENT prescribed goblet load — value is reps, load only tags the record), 
  swing_test (two-hand swings in 60 s at the user's current swing implement; the 53-lb bell becomes eligible only after the form gate), 
  treadmill_12min_m (distance covered in 12 min at self-selected pace, incline 1%), 
  zone2_hold_min (minutes sustained in Zone 2 within a 30-min walk/jog on the treadmill).

PER-USER DAMAGE (0–55 per benchmark, averaged):
  imp_b     = (new_b − prev_b) / prev_b            // for treadmill_12min_m, push_max, plank_hold_s, swing_test, goblet reps, zone2_hold_min (all "higher is better"; there is no time-to-complete benchmark in this set)
  imp_pts_b = clamp(round(100 * imp_b), 0, 25)     // +25% improvement or more = full 25
  tier_pts_b = min(30, 15 * tier_climbs_b)         // 1 tier = 15, 2+ tiers = 30
  strike_b  = imp_pts_b + tier_pts_b               // 0–55
  damage_u  = round(mean over the 6 benchmarks of strike_b)   // 0–55; a benchmark not logged in the window scores 0
  prev_b for battle 1 = week-0 baseline; for later battles = the value from the previous benchmark week (or the last logged value if that week was missed).

COMBINED DAMAGE (Köhler conjunctive bonus — the weaker partner's number is counted twice):
  damage_duo = damage_sean + damage_cat + min(damage_sean, damage_cat)      // 0–165
  Displayed as three hits on the boss: "Sean hits for 31, Cat hits for 27, SYNERGY +27".

BOSS HP SCHEDULE (tapers because beginner improvement percentages shrink):
  battle 1 (wk 4)  "The Couch"        HP 75
  battle 2 (wk 8)  "The Stairwell"    HP 65
  battle 3 (wk 12) "The Fifty-Three"  HP 60   (bonus: if BOTH users have passed the 53-lb swing form gate by resolution, +10 damage "Bell Strike")
  battle 4 (wk 16) "Iron Vest"        HP 55   (bonus: +5 if both logged >= 2 vest sessions in the block)
  battle 5+ (wk 20, 24 …) "Season Titan" HP 50
  Sanity check: week 4 beginners typically show +40–100% on push-ups/plank and 1 tier climb on 3–4 benchmarks → damage_u ≈ 25–35 each → damage_duo ≈ 75–105 vs HP 75: winnable but not automatic. Week 12: +10–20% typical, 0–1 tier climbs → damage_u ≈ 15–25 → duo ≈ 45–75 vs HP 60.

OUTCOMES:
  damage_duo >= 1.5 * HP  → "FLAWLESS" (boss trophy gold; badge boss_flawless)
  damage_duo >= HP        → "DEFEATED" (boss trophy; badge boss_slayer on first)
  damage_duo >= 0.75 * HP → "WOUNDED" — boss carries its remaining HP into a 1-week REMATCH: users may re-test up to 2 benchmarks each within 7 days; only improvements over the battle values count, added to damage_duo. If still not defeated, the boss "escapes" (no penalty, cabinet shows a grey silhouette with "escaped wk 8 — returns wk 16": the same boss returns at its HP with a +10 bonus for revenge).
  damage_duo < 0.75 * HP  → "ESCAPED" directly (same as above).
  There is never HP loss for the users, no XP loss, no penalty of any kind.

LOOT (all deterministic, no server): on DEFEATED both users receive +10% of that week's xp_available_week as bonus XP (the single-player system exposes xp_available_week; bonus is written into each user's own file by their own phone); on FLAWLESS +20%. Each defeated boss unlocks a cosmetic app theme (colour palette + belt skin) for both users. Boss trophies appear in the shared Crown Cabinet with the two hit numbers and the synergy number.

ONE PARTNER CANNOT TEST: if a user has >= 3 shield days in the benchmark week, the window extends 7 days (max one extension). If still incomplete at close, the battle becomes SOLO for the partner who tested: HP × 0.5, no synergy term, result recorded as "solo" — counts toward boss_slayer for that user only, never as a duo defeat, and the boss also returns as a rematch at the next benchmark week so the duo can still beat it together.

EQUIPMENT SHARING NOTE: benchmarks that use the single bell / dumbbells / vest are logged with the implement id; both users can test in the same session back-to-back and the app shows a "partner tested this today — implement is free" hint (no scheduling logic beyond that).

duo_badges.name: First Light
duo_badges.criterion: First calendar date on which both users have day_status == "trained" (duo streak reaches 1 for the first time).

duo_badges.name: Week of Two
duo_badges.criterion: duo_streak >= 7 (seven duo-required days in a row both trained; neutral rest/shield days do not count toward 7 but do not break it).

duo_badges.name: Rekindled
duo_badges.criterion: A stored ember (floor(prev_streak/2), prev_streak >= 6) is consumed: 3 consecutive duo-required days both trained before ember_expires.

duo_badges.name: Dead Heat
duo_badges.criterion: Two consecutive contested weeks resolve with |S_a − S_b| < 2 and both S >= 75.

duo_badges.name: Seesaw
duo_badges.criterion: The belt changes hands in 3 consecutive contested weeks (winner alternates A, B, A).

duo_badges.name: First Blood
duo_badges.criterion: First boss battle with result DEFEATED or FLAWLESS where damage_duo (not solo) >= HP.

duo_badges.name: Flawless
duo_badges.criterion: Any duo boss battle with damage_duo >= 1.5 * HP.

duo_badges.name: Indispensable
duo_badges.criterion: A duo boss battle is DEFEATED where damage_duo >= HP but (damage_sean + damage_cat) < HP — i.e. the min(A,B) synergy term made the difference. Awarded to both.

duo_badges.name: One Bell, Two Warriors
duo_badges.criterion: Both users' profiles have swing_form_gate_passed == true (53-lb kettlebell unlocked for both).

duo_badges.name: In Step
duo_badges.criterion: On 10 distinct dates, both users logged sessions whose start_time values are within 15 minutes of each other (trained together).

duo_badges.name: 190 Club
duo_badges.criterion: A contested week where S_sean + S_cat >= 190.

duo_badges.name: Two Hearts
duo_badges.criterion: 4 consecutive weeks (contested or not) in which both users have zone2_pct == 100.

duo_badges.name: Iron Block
duo_badges.criterion: Within one 4-week program block, both users have sessions_completed >= 22 (of 24 prescribed).

partner_visibility_ui:
HOME SCREEN — "Partner card" (always visible, below your own today card):
- Avatar + name + status line for today: "Cat trained today ✓ · 07:12 · Push A · 44 min" or "Cat — not yet today" (copy is never "missed", "skipped", or a red X). If today is Cat's rest day: "Cat — rest day". If Cat declared a shield: "Cat — travelling (day 2 of 3)". If Cat's synced data is older than 6 hours: append "as of 2 h ago" — the app never asserts absence from stale data.
- Duo streak: two-flame icon with count; one flame lit + "pending" when exactly one partner has trained today; ember indicator "Rekindle: 3 days to restore 12" when an ember is live.
- Belt line: "Cat holds the belt · 2nd defence" or "You hold the belt · Sean is 6 points behind, 3 days left".
- Mini scoreboard: two stacked bars (your S vs partner's S, provisional) with the five category percentages on tap; ladder step NAMES gained this week for both ("Sean: Swing → DB 35 lb").
- Reactions row: tap 🔥 / 👏 / 💪 on the partner's latest session (writes to your own file; partner sees "Sean sent 🔥 for your Tuesday session" on next open). Max 3 reactions/day to keep it meaningful.
- Boss banner when a battle is open: boss art, HP bar, "Cat has logged 4/6 benchmarks · you 2/6".

MID-WORKOUT (session screen):
- Header chip: "Cat did this session yesterday · hit 7/8" — hit count only, at her step, no loads.
- Per-exercise row (optional toggle in settings, default ON): a small tick if the partner hit this exercise's target the last time she did it, shown as "Cat ✓ Incline II" — step name, no reps/loads. This is the moment-of-effort Köhler cue.
- Equipment hint when both have trained today: "Cat used the bell at 07:30 — it's free" (no scheduling logic).
- End-of-session summary: "Logged. Cat will see: Push A, 44 min, 8/8 targets, +1 step" — an explicit preview of exactly what syncs, so the visibility contract is transparent every time.

WEEKLY RESOLUTION SCREEN: both scores, five category bars, belt outcome, loser's-best line, closing-gap line, PB star, share-card button.

NEVER SHOWN TO THE PARTNER (not synced at all, local-only per phone): body weight, waist/any measurements, progress photos, RPE/effort ratings, pain or injury notes, free-text session notes, heart-rate values (only Zone-2 MINUTES sync, never bpm), the weighted-vest weight and dumbbell loads by default, benchmark raw VALUES by default (tiers and improvement percentages sync; the raw number does not), shield reasons beyond the category word (sick/travel/injury/life — no detail), and the placement-quiz answers.
OPT-IN "SHARE MY NUMBERS" (per user, default off, settable at any time, applies going forward): when on, the partner can see your loads and reps on exercise detail screens and raw benchmark values. Even when on, body metrics, RPE, notes and photos are still never synced — there is no toggle for them.
nudges_without_notifications:
All nudges are computed at app open (and on foreground resume) from local data plus a fresh fetch of the partner's files; there are no push notifications and no scheduled jobs. Each nudge has a condition, a priority, a copy template, and a cap. Show at most ONE competitive nudge and ONE co-op nudge per open, max 3 nudge displays per day per phone; a dismissed nudge does not reappear the same day. Nothing competitive is shown before 12:00 local, on the user's rest day, on a shield day, or on any day where the partner's data is more than 24 h stale.

Priority order (first match wins within its class):
CO-OP CLASS
1. Sync delta ("New from Cat"): partner file updated since last open → "New from Cat: 2 sessions, Squat → 20 lb, 🔥 on your Tuesday."
2. Duo streak at risk: time >= 18:00, today duo-required, partner trained, you have not → "Duo streak 12 — train tonight to keep it. Pull B is ~45 min."
3. Ember live: "Rekindle window: 2 more shared days restores your streak to 12 (expires Sun)."
4. Boss window: benchmark week upcoming (next Monday) → "Boss 'The Couch' opens Monday — both of you need all 6 benchmarks."; during the window → "Cat has 4/6 benchmarks logged, you have 2/6 — 5 days left."
5. Partner milestone: partner's synced file shows a new ladder step or badge since last open → "Cat earned 'Bell Unlocked' — send a 🔥?"
6. Reaction received: "Sean sent 💪 for your Thursday session."
COMPETITIVE CLASS
7. Belt within reach (Thu–Sun only): compute the smallest single action that flips the provisional result (try: +1 session, +Zone-2 to 100%, +fidelity) → "Cat leads 78–71. One Zone-2 session would put you ahead." If no single action flips it, say nothing.
8. Sessions gap (Wed–Sat only, gap >= 2): "Sean is 2 sessions ahead this week." Never shown Mon/Tue (too early to be meaningful), never shown when the partner is on a shield, never shown if your gap is due to your own shield days.
9. Partner-done-today (after 12:00, partner trained, you have not, not already shown as streak-at-risk): "Cat's done for today (Push A, 42 min). Your session: Legs A, ~45 min."
10. Belt holder's defence reminder (holder only, Sat–Sun, provisional result shows you losing): "Sean is 4 points up — the belt is on the line tomorrow."
POST-SESSION (inline, not a banner): "Cat will see this ✓" on save; if the session put you ahead provisionally: "That moves you ahead 74–71 (provisional)."

Cadence safety rules: a losing partner (consecutive_losses >= 2) receives NO competitive-class nudges until they win or a dead heat/alliance week occurs — they only get co-op-class nudges; an Alliance Week shows only "Alliance Week: 150 combined wins it for both — you're at 112." Copy never uses "behind", "losing", "lazy", "missed", "failed", or exclamation-heavy pressure; the format is fact + one concrete next action.

Implementation: nudges are pure functions nudge(me, partner, now) → {id, class, text, action_deeplink}; show/dismiss history is localStorage-only.
anti_patterns_avoided: Comparing absolute loads, reps, speeds or volume anywhere in scoring or UI (default off; opt-in per user for detail screens only).
Shaming copy: no 'missed', 'skipped', 'failed', 'behind', red X marks, or skull icons — absence is 'not yet today' and unexplained absence at week end is 'sat this week out'.

One-sided losing streaks: 3 consecutive contested losses forces an Alliance Week; losing partners get no competitive nudges; every losing week surfaces the loser's best category and a PB star when earned.
Punishing the healthy partner for the sick partner: shields make days neutral, weeks become No Contest, boss windows extend, solo-battle fallback exists.
All-or-nothing weeks: fidelity averages over sessions completed, sessions_prescribed shrinks by shield days, minimum 2 sessions each for a contest.
Rewarding overtraining: every category and the total cap at 100; Zone-2 above prescription earns nothing; training on a rest day earns no duo day.
Hidden handicaps or secretly easier ladders for the weaker partner: no handicap coefficients; the only asymmetry is the transparent placement start step.
Leaderboards or any sync of body weight, measurements, photos, RPE, pain notes or heart-rate values.
Ties broken by trivial margins: |ΔS| < 2 is a Dead Heat, a legitimate result.
Streak anxiety: rest days are neutral, 48 h grace for late logging, retroactive shields, ember-based recovery so a break costs half rather than everything, longest streak displayed forever.
Nudge spam: max 3 per day, one competitive per open, nothing competitive before noon or on rest/shield days or from stale data.
Requiring simultaneity: everything is asynchronous; 'trained together' is a bonus badge, never a requirement.
Mutable shared state: belt and crowns are replayed from locked weekly results, never stored as a counter, so a late sync corrects itself and the two phones cannot diverge permanently.
Both phones writing the same file: each user writes only users/<me>/**; the other user's files are read-only.
Boss battles that only the stronger partner can carry: damage_duo = A + B + min(A,B) makes the weaker partner's number count twice.
Public exposure: share cards are rendered locally and never committed; the repo contains only percentages, step names, tiers and session metadata.
data_needed:
Each phone writes ONLY users/<me>/… and reads users/<partner>/… (raw.githubusercontent.com with a cache-busting query param, or the Contents API with the fine-grained PAT). Files the scoreboard reads from the PARTNER:

1. users/<partner>/profile.json
   - display_name (string)
   - rest_weekday (0–6)
   - timezone (IANA string; both should match)
   - program_start_date (YYYY-MM-DD; defines program week numbers and benchmark weeks — must be identical for both, copied from Sean's at Cat's onboarding)
   - share_numbers (bool, default false)
   - swing_form_gate_passed (bool) and swing_form_gate_date
   - schema_version, updated_at (ISO datetime)

2. users/<partner>/weeks/<ISO week, e.g. 2026-W37>.json  (one file per user per week; rewritten whole on each log)
   - week_id, updated_at, schema_version
   - days: { "YYYY-MM-DD": { status: "trained"|"rest"|"shield"|"none", shield_kind: "sick"|"travel"|"injury"|"life"|null } }
   - sessions: [ { session_id, date, start_time (ISO datetime), duration_min, template_id, template_name, status: "complete"|"partial", exercises_prescribed (int), exercises_hit (int), exercise_hits: { exercise_id: bool }  // hit/miss only, no loads, zone2_min (int), xp_earned (int) } ]
   - sessions_prescribed (int, after shield reduction), zone2_min_prescribed (int), xp_available_week (int)   // published by the single-player engine for that user's prescribed week
   - ladder_steps_end: { ladder_id: step_index }                                 // snapshot at last write
   - steps_gained: [ { ladder_id, from_step, to_step, to_step_name, date } ]
   - xp_week (int)
   - benchmarks: { benchmark_id: { tier (0–5), tier_prev (0–5), imp_pct (rounded int, already computed by the owner's phone), date, value (present only if share_numbers == true) } }
   - reactions: [ { date, emoji, target_session_id } ]                             // reactions I sent to the partner
   - manual_no_contest: { active: bool, reason_kind: "life"|null }
   - result (written after Tuesday lock; used only for cross-check): { S_me, S_partner, status: "contested"|"no_contest"|"dead_heat"|"alliance", winner, partner_updated_at }

3. users/<partner>/badges.json — { badge_id: date_earned } (single-player and duo; the scoreboard reads it for 'partner milestone' nudges and for duo-badge criteria that need both sides, e.g. one_bell_two_warriors)

4. users/<partner>/boss/<battle_n>.json — { battle_n, damage (0–55), strikes: { benchmark_id: strike }, logged_benchmarks (int), solo: bool, resolved_at } (each user writes their own damage; both phones compute damage_duo and the outcome locally)

Fields the scoreboard NEVER reads because they are never synced (kept in localStorage/IndexedDB only): body_weight, measurements, photos, rpe, pain_flags, notes, heart_rate_bpm, vest_weight, dumbbell loads per set (unless share_numbers), placement-quiz answers, shield free-text.

Derived locally from the above (not synced): duo_streak, ember, belt holder, crown counts, consecutive_losses, alliance flag, nudge history. Sync freshness is judged from updated_at; a partner file whose updated_at is > 24 h old suppresses competitive nudges and labels the partner card 'as of N h ago'.
